games.summary: Edmonton (8-1-1) is first in the Pacific and Connor McDavid has 31 points in 10 games, but the goaltending is unsettled: Devon Levi, who started 7 of 10, will miss the game and Tristan Jarry is confirmed to start. Jarry's numbers are below expected so far, and Mattias Ekholm, one of the league's most valuable defensemen by on-ice impact, is out 1 to 2 weeks with a head injury; Edmonton recalled Matt Tomkins as the backup. Together they trim Edmonton from 60.8% to 56.8%. Toronto (6-4-2) is without John Tavares (lower body, not traveling on the four-game trip), Chris Tanev and Max Domi.
